decision: Keep these complete results as evidence. Remove the explicit graph measurement policy from the proposed integration and requalify the narrower ownership/persistence change in a separate cohort.
observation: All numerical and persistence checks passed. Batch 16 was consistently approximately 0.51-0.59% slower against baseline cache seed 0. Aggregate +0.25-0.28% hid that per-seed tradeoff. This did not exceed the predeclared 3% threshold, but motivated the smaller scope.
attribution_limit: Captured choices changed; these data do not isolate a single tactic as the cause. Baseline cache seed 1 was approximately neutral at batch 16.
comparison: Existing SGLang startup already uses v2 default-candidate selection plus v1 persistence. This is not a pure v1 versus v2 tuner comparison.
remaining_evidence: Raw per-lookup records, cache files, logits and logs retained in the private qualification archive; each compact record includes its raw-file SHA256.
